text.tspan: How the shell, Doom and the other programs take turns. Cooperative and single-CPU: no timer preemption.

g.text: A freshly exited context's row stays but is marked BLOCKED, so round-robin never re-enters freed pages (the SCRUM-111 bug). The next launch of that app destroys the row.
